# Fontes Opens the Books — and Finds a Drawer

In an unusually candid statement, Treasury Minister Alexander Fontes confirmed that the previous government left eight months of contractor bills unrecorded, and that interest to the Fund now consumes roughly a ninth of public revenue. Bond prices fell slightly in St. Veldra.
